verdict.rationale: The docs say on-demand deployments have "no hard rate limits" and "no rate limits," in contrast to serverless. That implies serverless traffic is rate-limited, but the pack never states the actual serverless limits. The Priority tier (less likely to be load shed) and reserved throughput (guaranteed capacity) concern availability, not documented per-tier rate limits, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: published serverless rate-limit values (RPM/TPM), documentation of how limits scale across usage or spend tiers, guidance on raising limits, and independent corroboration.
